errors.text_span: The plot illustrates the layer-wise relative change in performance for different quantization and token configuration settings in the KV cache compression of Llama-3-8B-Instruct, using SnapKV as the pruning method.
errors.evidence: This information is taken from the paper caption, not the figure itself. It constitutes an interpretation beyond what is explicitly shown in the visual data.
The value for the yellow line (LB-Avg of 2xtokens, 8-bit) at Layer13-20 is almost exactly 0%, not 1%.
The final value for the yellow line (LB-Avg of 2xtokens, 8-bit) is approximately 0.5%, not 2%. The stated value is a significant overestimation.
The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1xtokens, 16-bit) begins at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, not near 0%.
The value for the dark blue line at Layer21-28 is approximately -11%, as it is visibly below the -10% gridline, making -10% an inaccurate approximation.
